cloudflare.workers.cpu_ms.note: Standard usage model. The first 30 million CPU ms a month are free units, included in Workers Paid for the whole account ("30 million CPU milliseconds included per month", https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
